definitions.label: Top-win band ends
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: Second win band ends
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: Strong nonconference band ends
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: First loss band starts
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: First loss band ends
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: Severe loss band starts
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: Weak nonconference band starts
definitions.basis: Published band: 2025–26 NCAA pre-championship manual, Factor IV.

definitions.label: Scheduling threshold
definitions.basis: Interpretation: at least 50% of completed nonconference matches.

definitions.label: Top-win bonus
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Added per win in first band

definitions.label: Second-band win bonus
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Added per win in second band

definitions.label: First-band loss penalty
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Subtracted per loss in first loss band

definitions.label: Severe loss penalty
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Subtracted per loss in severe band or vs non-D1

definitions.label: Strong-schedule bonus
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Added once when strong share meets threshold

definitions.label: Weak-schedule penalty
definitions.basis: Working amount, inferred from 2019 NCAA tables; not confirmed for 2026.
definitions.application: Subtracted once when weak share meets threshold
